Package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.datastore.parquetfile.properties

Class ParquetColumnChunk

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.datastore.parquetfile.properties.ParquetColumnChunk
public class ParquetColumnChunk extends Object
ParquetColumnChunk describes the values stored for one column in one row group.
